faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Accounts Assistant post at Air Force School Naraina?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Accounts Assistant post is 12 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Accounts Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Com degree from a government-recognized university, along with knowledge of accounts and book-keeping. A typing speed of at least 40 words per minute in English and basic computer application skills are also necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Accounts Assistant post is between 25 to 50 years. Age relaxations are applicable for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Accounts Assistant job?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted via email to [email protected] or by post/in person to The Headmistress, Air Force School Naraina, Brar Square, Delhi Cantt, New Delhi - 110010.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Accounts Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated amount of Rs. 18,500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Accounts Assistant.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Accounts Assistant position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Does Air Force School Naraina offer age relaxation for any categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for women, physically challenged individuals, ex-servicemen, and former Air Force School staff, as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
